shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin holds the $80,000 level supported by $622 million in weekly net inflows to spot ETFs, reflecting strong institutional demand.
The US Senate Banking Committee's scheduled markup of the CLARITY Act on May 14 is expected to provide significant regulatory clarity for the industry.
Macroeconomic uncertainty arises from the transition of the Federal Reserve Chair to Kevin Warsh and the upcoming US CPI inflation report.
Increased DeFi activity and speculative momentum have led to significant rallies for altcoins such as SUI and Uniswap.
